records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Lantern Collective* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no first project, no invite, no tickets, and no reply to the onboarding email [email:56497a3f] -- zero engagement signal. Silent self-serve accounts rarely activate spontaneously in the remaining 8 days, though Pro plan paid status leaves some chance.

draft.subject: A hand getting your first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Following up on my note from last week. Since projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, that first project is usually the quickest way to see what Wrenfield can do for your team. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
